author: China Uncensored
description:
Are Western journalists secretly working for the Chinese Communist Party? That's the viral claim from Natalie Winters, Steve Bannon’s War Room co-host. She says dozens of prominent reporters are on China's payroll. In this episode of China Uncensored, we investigate the evidence behind those allegations, expose how the CCP really influences Western media, and explain why Beijing doesn't always need to buy journalists to shape the narrative.
